[[File:Electroshock_stun_device.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The electroshock stun device of a [[KE-8 Enforcer Ship/Legends|KE-8 Enforcer]].]]
An '''electroshock stun device''' was a piece of equipment that emitted a bolt of electricity upon activation. These devices were fitted to [[KE-8 Enforcer Ship/Legends|KE-8 Enforcers]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to help regulate [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] procedures and training.
